architecture_summary: Modular React app. Each Stitch screen map to dedicated page component in src/pages/. Shared UI components extracted from repeated patterns in duolingo_card_components_showcase. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management library (use React context + useReducer for global state). Static data files for mock content until API ready.

tickets.title: Create shared UI component library from duolingo_card_components_showcase
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from duolingo_card_components_showcase. Components: Card, Button, ProgressBar, Avatar, Badge, Modal, Tooltip. Use Tailwind classes for styling. Export from src/components/index.js. Storybook stories optional but recommended for visual regression testing.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind classes used exclusively (no custom CSS files)
Components support dark mode via Tailwind dark: variant

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_landing_page as LandingPage component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_landing_page HTML to React component. Use shared UI components from TASK-001. Static data for hero section, features, testimonials. Responsive layout with Tailwind. Mobile menu toggle use native details/summary elements if possible, else minimal JS.

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_learning_dashboard as LearningDashboard component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_learning_dashboard HTML to React component. Use shared UI components. Static data for courses, progress, streaks. Progress bars use ProgressBar component. Course cards use Card component. Layout use CSS Grid for course grid, Flexbox for sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Progress bars update dynamically (static data for now)

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_profile_page as ProfilePage component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_profile_page HTML to React component. Use shared UI components. Static data for user stats, achievements, friends. Avatar component for user image. Badge component for achievements. Layout use Flexbox for stats, CSS Grid for achievements grid.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive layout (achievements grid wrap on mobile)

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_pricing_page as PricingPage component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_pricing_page HTML to React component. Use shared UI components. Static data for pricing tiers. Card component for pricing cards. Button component for CTA. Layout use CSS Grid for pricing cards, Flexbox for features list.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive layout (pricing cards stack on mobile)

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_learning_table as LearningTable component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_learning_table HTML to React component. Use shared UI components. Static data for lessons, progress. Table layout use CSS Grid for rows/columns. ProgressBar component for lesson progress. Tooltip component for lesson details.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive layout (table scroll horizontally on mobile)

tickets.title: Implement duolingo_style_guide_page as StyleGuidePage component
tickets.description: Convert duolingo_style_guide_page HTML to React component. Document color palette, typography, spacing, components. Use shared UI components. Layout use CSS Grid for sections, Flexbox for component previews.
acceptance_criteria: All shared components documented with props and examples
Color palette documented with Tailwind class names
Typography documented with font sizes, weights, line heights

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App shell with navigation bar. Use React Router v6 for routing. Navigation links point to implemented pages. Mobile-responsive navbar with toggle. Dark mode toggle in navbar. Layout use CSS Grid for main content, Flexbox for navbar. Error boundary for 404 page.
acceptance_criteria: All implemented pages accessible via navigation
Dark mode toggle functional (persist to localStorage)
